taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-09, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-09, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-09, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model at T-09 comprises four layers. Resistivity decreases from 975.4 Ω·m (Layer 1) to 552.4 Ω·m (Layer 2), then increases to 730.5 Ω·m (Layer 3) and further to 1710.8 Ω·m (Layer 4), with Layer 3 terminating at a depth of 25.81 m. This sequence reflects a resistive surface layer, an underlying conductive zone, and a deeper high-resistivity basement/substrate.

Applying the standard curve-type convention: for layers 1-2-3 (975.4 > 552.4 < 730.5) the pattern is H-type; for layers 2-3-4 (552.4 < 730.5 < 1710.8) the pattern is A-type. The correct curve designation is therefore **HA**, not AA as listed in the file. The drilling team should be aware of this discrepancy when correlating with regional curve-type groupings.

{"curve_type_stated": "HA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
